verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party connector or AI-plugin ecosystem that lets external LLMs or AI tools reach a user's notes: no MCP server, no llms.txt, no AI plugin directory. The in-app AI palette's GPT-4o/Claude toggle is a built-in assistant feature, which is adjacent rather than this capability. The OAuth REST API and the generic Zapier integration are developer building blocks, and the API docs state notes are end-to-end encrypted so their contents cannot be served through the API.
